github.description: GitHub MCP server — PRs, issues, files, checks, code search.
github.notes: Token needs classic PAT 'repo' scope (private repos) or the fine-grained equivalents for the resources you want (Pull requests: read/write, Issues: read/write, Contents: read, Actions: read). Create one at https://github.com/settings/tokens. The Docker image pulls on first run. For a hosted alternative without Docker, see the github-mcp-server README for the HTTP transport against api.githubcopilot.com (requires a GitHub Copilot subscription).

mcp-atlassian.notes: Cloud (atlassian.net): set JIRA_USERNAME + JIRA_API_TOKEN. Create the token at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Server / Data Center: set JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN (Personal Access Token from your Jira profile). Install uvx via 'curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh'. Docker / pipx alternatives are in the upstream README.
